legend: On Bertown's main street n trees are growing, the tree number i has the height of ai meters (1 ≤ i ≤ n). By the arrival of the President of Berland these trees were decided to be changed so that their heights formed a beautiful sequence. This means that the heights of trees on ends (the 1st one and the n-th one) should be equal to each other, the heights of the 2-nd and the (n - 1)-th tree must also be equal to each other, at that the height of the 2-nd tree should be larger than the height of the first tree by 1, and so on. In other words, the heights of the trees, standing at equal distance from the edge (of one end of the sequence) must be equal to each other, and with the increasing of the distance from the edge by 1 the tree height must also increase by 1. For example, the sequences "2 3 4 5 5 4 3 2" and "1 2 3 2 1" are beautiful, and '1 3 3 1" and "1 2 3 1" are not.

Changing the height of a tree is a very expensive operation, using advanced technologies invented by Berland scientists. In one operation you can choose any tree and change its height to any number, either increase or decrease. Note that even after the change the height should remain a positive integer, i. e, it can't be less than or equal to zero. Identify the smallest number of changes of the trees' height needed for the sequence of their heights to become beautiful.
input: The first line contains integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 105) which is the number of trees. The second line contains integers ai (1 ≤ ai ≤ 105) which are the heights of the trees.
output: Print a single number which is the minimal number of trees whose heights will have to be changed for the sequence to become beautiful.

legend.ai: 在 Bertown 的主街上生长着 n 棵树，第 i 棵树的高度为 ai 米（1 ≤ i ≤ n）。为了迎接 Berland 总统，人们决定改变这些树，使它们的高度构成一个美丽序列。这意味着，两端的树（第 1 棵和第 n 棵）的高度应彼此相等，第 2 棵和第 n−1 棵树的高度也必须彼此相等，同时第 2 棵树的高度应比第 1 棵树高 1，依此类推。换句话说，距边缘（序列某一端）距离相同的树，其高度必须相等；而距离边缘每增加 1，树的高度也必须增加 1。例如，序列“2 3 4 5 5 4 3 2”和“1 2 3 2 1”是美丽的，而“1 3 3 1”和“1 2 3 1”不是。
改变树的高度是一项非常昂贵的操作，需要使用 Berland 科学家发明的先进技术。在一次操作中，你可以选择任意一棵树，并将其高度改为任意数值，可以增加也可以减少。注意，改变后高度仍必须是正整数，即不能小于或等于零。请确定使树高序列变为美丽序列所需的最少修改次数。

input.ai: 第一行包含整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5），表示树的数量。第二行包含整数 a_i（1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^5），表示这些树的高度。

output.ai: 输出一个数字，表示为了使序列变得美丽，必须改变树高的树的最少数量。
